scope: Original 2026-10-11 set: the 13 remaining distinct, non-composite O/early-B (B0-B5) entries with catalog Teff below 10000 K flagged after the Zeta1 Sco correction. Extended 2026-10-26: 42 further O/B/A entries whose McDonald et al. 2012 broadband SED temperature lies more than 20 percent below the frozen SIMBAD mesFe_h consensus, plus Nu Hya and Wasat, whose SED fits are far hotter than every catalogued value. This is a reviewed candidate set, not a blanket temperature cut or full stellar-catalog audit. Extended 2026-10-28: 14 further O/B entries inherited through the retired bright catalog or selected from the Allende Prieto & Lambert 1999 models, whose temperature lies more than 20 percent from the frozen SIMBAD mesFe_h consensus, including the far too hot Algenib fit.
policy: Exact SIMBAD/HIP/HD and stable IDs only. Keep heterogeneous temperatures and component scope explicit. Reject dependent luminosity/radius when the original SED fit is unsuitable; do not infer a temperature from spectral type. Preserve membership, spectra, coordinates, motion and unrelated physical fields.
